policy: Development-only advisories with no published fix may be accepted for a short, dated period after review. Production advisories are never accepted here. `npm run audit:security` remains the strict release gate and still fails while any exception exists.

exceptions.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS from deeply nested brace patterns. braces 3.0.3 is the newest published version, so no patched release exists. Reached only through eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch during local/CI linting, with glob patterns from this repository's own configuration, not untrusted input. Not present in `npm audit --omit=dev` and not shipped in the static export. npm's suggested fix downgrades eslint-config-next to 14.x, which is incompatible with Next 16.
